title: ItemList is unexpectedly scrolling up
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot 4.3 stable and v4.4.dev.custom_build.2582793d4


### System information

Windows 10 64 bits NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB

### Issue description

I have a UI made with containers. One of them contains an `ItemList`, another contains a `VBoxContainer` "inspector" in which I dynamically add controls to. The two are reasonably separated by a "flexible" middle control using split containers:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/89cef381-ce31-4ecc-be8f-590b49ef3abf)

I want to repopulate the "inspector" with new controls when I select items of the list.
Problem: when the list is scrolled down and I click one of the last items, it unexpectedly scrolls up, sometimes all the way, hiding the selected item in the process.
It seems to be doing that only if I add "enough" controls to the "inspector".

### Steps to reproduce

Have this hierarchy of controls:
```
- HS1 (HSplitContainer)
  - ItemList with minimum width of 100px
  - HS2 (HSplitContainer)
    - ColorRect with horizontal size flag set to EXPAND FILL
    - Inspector (VBoxContainer) with minimum width of 100px
```
- Have a script that populates the `ItemList` with 16 items on `_ready` (maybe the numbers vary with how controls are sized, I don't know; check the MRP otherwise)
- Connect `item_selected` to a function that queue_frees children and adds controls to `Inspector` (labels, optionbuttons, spinboxes... dunno if the type matters)
- Launch the scene
- Scroll down to the last item
- Select the last item. This populates the inspector.
- Select the item before the last: observe the list scrolls up. It should not scroll up.
- Scroll back down and select the last item: observe it scrolls up again, etc

In my project I have it worse than that, it scrolls all the way up and makes it annoying to use.
In other scenarios, I select the item in the list with `select` based on other factors, followed by `ensure_current_is_visible`, but the same issue occurs, the list doesn't scroll where it should be and the item is not visible.
I even tried deferring the update of the inspector, but the issue still happens.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ItemListWeirdScrollUp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18311928/ItemListWeirdScrollUp.zip)
